results.name: Pit
results.description:
A 3D print project I did a while ago - it is a figure of Pit, the protagonist from the Nintendo game "Kid Icarus" who also appears in "Super Smash Bros". 
The client provided a low-resolution mesh which I used as a reference point to build the sculpt. Had a lot of fun on this one. 
This was supposed to fully painted statue/figure of him, but for some reason, it never went into production. 
I think it might have made for a nice figure to put on your desk.
